description: Submit the user's pending choice. Set action_type to a value from pending_gate_payload.allowed_actions. In Review each step, action_type is required; confirmed_by_user=true is preferred and is not a substitute for it. In Run it for me, omit action_type and payload to advance one milestone, and do not ask the user to choose – show the user that milestone's Auto-complete decision receipt and pipe-table. Do not ask them to approve it. Call send_action once per result, and only again on the next result while next_tool is send_action. When next_tool is submit_prd, stop and offer submission. An approve moves one phase: stories to requirements, requirements to the technical spec, then the tech spec to the estimate. In Review each step, stories_reject, requirements_reject, and techspec_reject show the current table again and wait. When the user describes the change, call send_turn with their exact words and show the regenerated table that comes back. mode_select_a, mode_select_b, and mode_select_c are only the How much time pick: Normal, Quick estimate, or Detailed. Do not use them for Review each step or Run it for me. That choice is send_turn with interaction_mode. For clarifying_questions_submit, set payload.answers by question id with the letter only, such as {"q1":"A","q2":"B"}, not "1A". A plain reply such as "1B, 2A, 3C", or any wording that combines options, goes through send_turn. Do not split one question into several letters.

action_type.description: Widget action type from allowed_actions. Optional in auto_complete; defaults fill the pending gate.

confirmed_by_user.description: Preferred when the user explicitly chose. Not required when action_type is already set to an allowed_actions value with a complete payload.

interview_handle.description: Opaque interview handle from start_session. Pass it on every later tool.

name: send_action
title: Submit the pending choice
